evidence.quote: Gumroad's OAuth 2.0 API lets you see information about your products
To start using the API, you'll need to register your OAuth application.

auth_methods.why: Docs describe OAuth 2.0 only; access tokens (including self-generated ones) are sent as an access_token request parameter, not a distinct bearer scheme.

rationale: Official docs describe an OAuth 2.0 API; access_token passed as a parameter. Client-credentials routes are for partner apps only.
